card.name: Inside foreign names and transliterations
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through proper names or transliterated foreign words, such as Persian, Greek, Japanese or Finnish names. It fires on the middle of the name, not on common English words.

modes.label: Non-Latin or transliterated words
modes.description: Middle pieces of words written in or transliterated from Persian, Greek or Japanese.

modes.label: Split personal and place names
modes.description: Middle pieces of people's names or other proper names split into parts.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual foreign names and transliterated words.
